frame.title: Avg Unit Price: Promotion vs Normal

lines:
## Year-over-Year Trends

**2014**: Peak performance year with R75.4M in sales

**2015**: -15.1% decline to R64.0M

**2016**: -26.6% decline to R47.0M

**Key Insight**: Sales have declined 37.7% from 2014 peak, indicating sustained downward trend requiring strategic intervention.
